```{ojs}
// Link to tutorial
// https://observablehq.com/@observablehq/plot-cyclical-time-scale

SNOTEL = (await FileAttachment("Data/Snow Water Equivalent.csv").csv()).map(d => ({
  ...d,
  Date: new Date(d.Date + "T00:00:00"), // adjusts for JS messing with time zone
  //Normalized_Date: new Date(2000, d.Date.getMonth(), d.Date.getDate()),
  //Month_Day: d.Date.toLocaleString("en-US", { month: "short", day: "2-digit", timeZone: "UTC" }),
  HUC6: d.HUC6,
  Minimum: +d.Min,
  Maximum: +d.Max,
  Median_91_20: +d.Median_91_20,
  Average_SWE: +d.Average_SWE
}))
```
```{ojs}
SNOTEL_Filtered = SNOTEL.filter(d => d.HUC6 === Basin_Select)
```
```{ojs}
viewof Basin_Select = Inputs.select(Array.from(new Set(SNOTEL.map(d => d.HUC6))).sort(),
  { label: "Basin:", value: "Full Basin" })
```
```{ojs}
{
    const Current_Year_Start = "2026-01-01";
    const Previous_Year_Start = "2025-01-01";
    const Previous_year_End = "2025-12-31";

    return Plot.plot({
        title: "Basin-Wide Average Snow Water Equivalent Trends",
        width: width,
        height: 500,
        color: { // For some reason adding the legend is causing the multi-year lines to disappear
            legend: true,
            domain: ["Current Water Year", "Median 1991-2020", "Minimum", "Maximum", "Previous Years"],
            range:  ["black", "#00c01a", "#f54242", "#3765fa", "#aaaaaa"]
            },
        x: {
            // map all dates to 2000 by removing n * 365.24 days; Feb 29 will not create a gap
            transform: (d) => d3.utcDay.offset(d, (2000 - d.getUTCFullYear()) * 365.24),
            tickFormat: "%b",
            line: true,
            label: "Month"
        },
        y: { nice: true, grid: true, zero: true, label: "Snow Water Equivalent (in)" },
        marks: [
            Plot.line(SNOTEL_Filtered, {
                x: "Date",
                y: "Average_SWE",
                stroke: "#aaaaaa",
                z: ({ Date }) => Date.getUTCFullYear(), // z separates the lines
                strokeOpacity: 0.3
                }),
            Plot.line(SNOTEL_Filtered, {
                filter: d => d.Date >= new Date(Previous_Year_Start) && d.Date <= new Date(Previous_year_End),
                x: "Date",
                y: "Median_91_20",
                stroke: "#00c01a",
                strokeWidth: 2,
                tip: {
                    pointer: "xy",
                    maxRadius: 8,
                    format: {
                        x: d => d3.utcFormat("%b %d")(d)
                    }
                }
            }),
            Plot.line(SNOTEL_Filtered, {
                filter: d => d.Date >= new Date(Previous_Year_Start) && d.Date <= new Date(Previous_year_End),
                x: "Date",
                y: "Minimum",
                stroke: "#f54242",
                strokeWidth: 3,
                tip: {
                    pointer: "xy",
                    maxRadius: 8,
                    format: {
                        x: d => d3.utcFormat("%b %d")(d)
                    }
                }
            }),
            Plot.line(SNOTEL_Filtered, {
                filter: d => d.Date >= new Date(Previous_Year_Start) && d.Date <= new Date(Previous_year_End),
                x: "Date",
                y: "Maximum",
                stroke: "#3765fa",
                strokeWidth: 3,
                tip: {
                    pointer: "xy",
                    maxRadius: 8,
                    format: {
                        x: d => d3.utcFormat("%b %d")(d)
                    }
                }
            }),
            Plot.line(SNOTEL_Filtered, {
                filter: d => d.Date >= new Date(Current_Year_Start),
                x: "Date",
                y: "Average_SWE",
                stroke: "#000000",
                strokeWidth: 3,
                tip: {
                    pointer: "xy",
                    maxRadius: 8,
                    format: {
                        x: d => d3.utcFormat("%b %d")(d)
                    }
                }
            })
        ]
    })
}
```
